select rtp.SEQNO seqno, rtp.ORG_CODE orgCode, rtp.REPORT_CODE reportCode, rtp.TYPE_DETAIL typeDetail, rtp.SUBMIT_TIMETYPE submitTimetype, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE3 submitRequire3, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE2 submitRequire2, rtp.SUBMIT_REQUIRE submitRequire, rtp.SUBMIT_POINT_BOND submitPointBond, rtp.SUBMIT_POINT_BANK submitPointBank, rtp.UPDATE_SUBMIT_POINT updateSubmitPoint, rtp.DELETE_SUBMING_POINT deleteSubmingPoint, rtp.STATUS status, rtp.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, rtp.UPDATE_USER updateUser, rtp.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, rtp.CREATE_USER createUser, rtp.CREATE_TIME createTime from CHB_REG_TIME_POINTS rtp where rtp.STATUS = 'E' and rtp.REPORT_CODE = #{reportCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and rtp.TYPE_DETAIL #{typeDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select deadline1.* from(select rownum num,deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.BUSI_DATE >= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '0'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1
select BUSI_DATE busiDate, MARKET_CODE marketCode, IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday from CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY where BUSI_DATE = #{busiDate,jdbcType=DATE} and MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT T.LARGE_SH_DATE FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T1 WHERE T.PROD_ID=T1.PROD_ID AND T1.AFTER_RAISE_MAX!=T.AFTER_RAISE_MAX AND T1.CHANGE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(CHANGE_DATE) FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA WHERE CHANGE_DATE < T.CHANGE_DATE)) AND IS_LARGE_SH='0' AND LARGE_SH_DATE = #{sysDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND PROD_ID= #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT count(1) FROM rep_fee_yield WHERE BUSI_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = 'E' AND START_DATE = #{sysDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND BUSI_ID IN ( SELECT BUSI_ID FROM rep_fee_yield where START_DATE < #{sysDate, jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY BUSI_ID HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 )

select deadline1.* from(select rownum num,deadline.* from( SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
A.BUSI_DATE >= to_date(#{holidayDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '0'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline )deadline1 where deadline1.num = 1
